data.name: Virochan
data.gender_notes: Virochan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Virochan is a Sanskrit name for a wise and intellectual leader. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vi' meaning 'in the presence of' and 'rochan' meaning 'vision, knowledge'. The name signifies one who has a deep understanding of the truth and is able to guide others with his wisdom. The name Virochan carries the meaning “Intellectual leader, knower of truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Virochan usually hope their child will grow to embody intellectual leader, knower of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is deeply spiritual and has a profound understanding of the truth. Virochan is a name for a wise and enlightened leader who is able to guide others on their spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Virochan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellectual leader, knower of truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Virochan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Virochan holds significant cultural importance in Hindu mythology and literature, particularly in the context of Jainism where Virochana is mentioned as the first king of the demon race, the Asuras. Despite being a demon king, Virochan is portrayed as a just and fair ruler who governs his subjects well. This portrayal of a wise and fair ruling demon emphasizes the importance of leadership qualities, wisdom, and justice in Hindu and Jain mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Virochan represents the inner wisdom and knowledge that each individual possesses. It is a reminder that one can attain great mastery and understanding of the world and truth with intelligence, insight, and introspection. The name serves as a call to strive for knowledge and wisdom in one's own life, and to use that knowledge to guide and lead others with compassion and understanding. Ultimately, the name Virochan inspires us to tap into our own inner wisdom and knowledge, and to be a source of guidance and light for those around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Virochan represents clarity and wisdom in perception. As the commander of the divine armies, he illuminates the path to victory with his discerning vision.

vedic_reference.note: Virochan is a name of Lord Indra, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. He is also known as the god of knowledge and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Virochana is considered the king of the Asuras or demons in Hindu mythology. He is the father of the ancient Danavas, including Hiranyakasipu and Hiranyaksha. According to Hindu texts, Virochana was born from the mind of the god Vishnu in the form of a boon granted to the demon king Hiranyaksha.

Another reference to Virochana can be found in the epic poem Mahabharata. In this text, Virochana is described as the king of the Asuras and the grandson of the demon king Vritra. He is a powerful and wise ruler, who is renowned for his knowledge and wisdom. He is also known for his deep devotion to Lord Shiva.

His name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Viruddh' meaning enemy or obstacle, and 'Chakra' meaning intellect or knowledge. In modern contexts, Virochan is often used in discussions related to astrology, where he is considered the planet of wisdom, knowledge, and good fortune. Additionally, Virochan's name has been associated with AI and machine learning due to the intellectual and analytical nature of these technologies. This trend is particularly prevalent on platforms like Google Search Trends, where searches for 'Virochan' and 'Jupiter' often include keywords related to technology and data analysis.
